module: Helper library of the console VM (BeamNG without the game): creates dummy Lua objects so that vehicle/physics code can run outside the full game, builds `ground_model` objects from the JSON description of ground materials, and reads art/groundmodels.json. Used by bananabench.
notes: `initConsole` defines dummy GLOBALS: physicsEngineEvent, vehicleReset, map (setNameForId, objectData), gameplay_statistic (metricAdd), core_sounds (setEngineSoundParameter, setEngineSoundParameterList, initExhaustSound, setExhaustSoundNodes, initEngineSound), all with no effect.

`createGroundModel` is marked TODO in the source: code duplicated from environment.lua (submitGroundModel). Default values: roughnessCoefficient 0, defaultDepth 0, staticFrictionCoefficient 1, slidingFrictionCoefficient 0.7, hydrodynamicFriction 0.01 (also accepts the misspelled key `hydrodnamicFriction`), stribeckVelocity 6, strength 1, fluidDensity 200, flowConsistencyIndex 10000, flowBehaviorIndex 0.5, dragAnisotropy 0, skidMarks false, shearStrength 0.
collisiontype: if it is a string, it is converted to a particle material identifier (particles.getOrAddMaterialIDByName), otherwise 0.

initConsole.desc: Creates the dummy globals needed to run vehicle code outside the game (map, gameplay_statistic, core_sounds, physicsEngineEvent, vehicleReset).

createGroundModel.desc: Creates and fills a native `ground_model()` object from a parameter table (friction coefficients, depth, roughness, fluid…) with the default values listed in the notes.

v.desc: Description of a ground material (entry of art/groundmodels.json).

readGroundModels.desc: Reads and returns the content of art/groundmodels.json.
